title: Training Note — Plan Activation and the Plan-Year Entitlements of the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Training Note — Plan Activation and the Plan-Year Entitlements of the Building Automation Service Plans

**When does a Building Automation Service Plan take effect?** A plan takes effect only when the customer's written acceptance of the quote is recorded against it, and the activation fee is charged on the day it takes effect, less any survey fee already paid. The acceptance is evidenced by the office's request records matched to that plan — the request for that plan, its type and its recorded outcome. A caller's account of having accepted the quote is not the record.

**What is credited at the start of a plan year?** At the start of each plan year the plan is credited with the tier's included support hours and included alarm responses; neither carries forward, and both are forfeited at the plan year end. The included hours and responses per tier, and the activation fee, are the figures of the tier schedules.

**When does monitoring start?** The remote connection is commissioned before monitoring starts, and until it is commissioned the alarm allowance is held but not drawn.

**What if the tier includes no alarm monitoring?** Where the tier includes no alarm monitoring, no alarm allowance is credited and alarms from that site reach nobody at the company, which the desk says plainly rather than implying the site is watched.

**Does an unused allowance survive the plan year?** No. Both the support hours and the alarm responses are forfeited at the plan year end, whatever remains.

**Activation fee illustration (hypothetical).** A plan whose tier carries an activation fee of 950 USD, quoted for a building where a survey fee of 650 USD was already paid, is charged 950 USD less 650 USD, that is 300 USD, on the day it takes effect. Where no survey fee was paid, the full 950 USD is charged.

| Situation | Plan takes effect | Activation fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| Written acceptance recorded against the plan | yes, on the day it takes effect | tier's activation fee less any survey fee already paid |
| No written acceptance recorded against the plan | no | not charged |
